description: This file declares functions for reading 16-bit and 32-bit integers from little endian and big endian formats, which are likely used internally for handling byte order conversions in the cURL library.

methods.name: Curl_read16_le
methods.description: Converts a 16-bit integer from little endian format.

methods.name: Curl_read32_le
methods.description: Converts a 32-bit integer from little endian format.

methods.name: Curl_read16_be
methods.description: Converts a 16-bit integer from big endian format.
